purpose: Prospective engine-family ontology separating same-semantic Stockfish lineage transport from heterogeneous-engine admissibility.

stockfish_lineage.admission_rule: A version enters P19 science only after byte-locked checkout, successful C3X semantic-read materialization, clean-vs-NATIVE/SHAM noninterference, telemetry completeness, and MASK_ALL=legacy MASKED equivalence.

lc0.family: neural-network guided tree search / MCTS-style search
lc0.reason: A Stockfish TT-read mask is not automatically the same causal operation on Lc0 search state or neural-cache/tree statistics.
future_admission_requires: constitute an abstract persistent-search-memory read interface
prove complete mediation of the targeted read class
define semantic removal whose causal role is comparable rather than merely syntactically similar
retain external exact-world adjudication independent of engine internals

external_alpha_beta_tt_engines.rule: Source availability and presence of a TT are insufficient. Each engine needs its own semantic-use census and intervention-equivalence proof before cross-engine comparison.

anti_reification: UCI compatibility does not imply mechanism equivalence.
A data structure named transposition table does not by itself define the same causal variable across engines.
Version chronology is an engine morphism axis only after intervention semantics are shown invariant enough for comparison.
Architecture class cannot be defined post hoc from P19 outcomes.
